text: You still answer your own fucking DMs, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Bro, private jet. This is how the big coaches live.
style: Hyped and proud, showing off to his buddy, a casual American guy living his dream for a day.

text: You rented it for an hour and spent forty minutes in your DMs.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring the last words.

text: Nah, big coaches answer their own DMs. That's trust.
style: Defensive and a bit smug, like he knows better.

text: Big coaches hire people for that. Read their job posts.
style: Sly and calm, a little smirk, handing him the proof.

text: Holy shit, three sixty-three K followers, and he's hiring someone?
style: Genuinely shocked, reading it out loud, voice going up at the end.

text: The coach films, the setter answers, the closer closes.
style: Matter-of-fact and rhythmic, three short beats, like explaining the obvious.

text: Wait, so I'm doing all three?
style: Slowly realizing, confused, a small pause after wait.

text: Yep, a one-man call center in a beanie.
style: Teasing and mocking, laughing at him, the last word savored.

text: Bro, I reply at midnight. I don't even like coaching anymore.
style: Deflated and tired, venting to a friend, honest.

text: Then copy their system, not their payroll.
style: Sly and confident, a little offer, slow on the last word.

text: So a bot? My leads hate bots.
style: Skeptical and wary, raising an eyebrow.

text: Plug me into ManyChat. I reply in your voice, only serious leads get your calendar.
style: Smooth and confident, listing it easily, proud.

text: You jump in whenever you want. A hundred nineteen bucks a month.
style: Calm and smug, a short beat between the two sentences, the price dropped casually.

text: Okay. How do I set you up?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: Hurry, this jet turns back into an Uber in ten minutes.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
